facts.fact: Bethany Peters 是 27 岁的跨性别女孩，在德州贫困线上挣扎，她唯一的愿望是自己的生活终于真正开始。
facts.anchor: She’s a twenty-seven-year-old trans girl playing chicken with the poverty line down in Texas, so right now she’s got more modest goals. All she wants—all Bethany Peters has ever wanted—is for her life to finally, actually start.

facts.fact: Bethany 不是 GlobalVill 正式员工、只是 contractor：夜班内容审核，每周六个晚上、每晚十点打卡，上班时白班员工早已下班、屋顶花园的门已锁到早上。
facts.anchor: But Bethany isn’t an employee, and she doesn’t work day shifts, so all that basil and thyme isn’t for her. Bethany’s just a contractor. By the time she clocks in at ten p.m. each night, all of the real employees have gone home.

facts.fact: 一个月前 Bethany 看到 GlobalVill.com 的招聘广告 “We want you!!!” 后深夜一时兴起提交了申请，之后在男友 Abel 的笔记本进入睡眠前就忘了自己申请过这回事。
facts.anchor:
“We want you!!!” the ad read.


It felt good to be wanted, so Bethany submitted an application. It was a middle-of-the-night whim she didn’t actually expect to lead anywhere. She forgot she’d even applied before she put her boyfriend Abel’s laptop to sleep for the night.

facts.fact: 经理 Douglas 的电话面试当场录用她（pending physical、drug test），整场不到四分钟；面试里他只 vague 地说加入 “Trust and Integrity” 团队、做 “user safety on the platform”；他的欢迎词称 CEO Anthony ‘Fisch’ Fischer 与兄弟 2007 年从 RadioShack 员工储物间创办 GlobalVill.com，如今是全球第二大 user-led streaming community、在超过六个主要城市有办公室。
facts.anchor: This was the vision our CEO Anthony ‘Fisch’ Fischer had when he and his brother launched GlobalVill.com out of a RadioShack staff closet all the way back in 2007. And since those humble beginnings, GlobalVill has grown into the world’s second-largest user-led streaming community, with offices in over six major cities.

facts.fact: 首个夜班 Bethany 先在前台与老夜警卫 Rusty 签到；当晚队列里出现 31 部业余成人色情视频（含 X 级 Simpsons 色情戏仿）、6 条对镜头吸食硬毒品、蜘蛛侠注射海洛因的卡通、4 部带高威力突击步枪的狩猎视频等。
facts.anchor: Thirty-one amateur adult videos (including an X-rated Simpsons porn parody where Marge gets railed by a bulky, tattooed Principal Skinner), six uploads of people doing hard drugs for the camera, a cartoon of Spider-Man injecting heroin, four hunting videos featuring high-powered assault rifles

facts.fact: 次日早上回到与男友 Abel 同住的 North Austin 家后，她 Google 调研发现内容审核争议的网络报道可追溯到近十年前、有审核员带枪上班；她对自己保证宁可辞职回 Gap——“Thirty an hour wasn’t worth her sanity.”
facts.anchor: Bethany made a promise to herself. She’d quit before she let that happen to her. She’d go back to the Gap. Thirty an hour wasn’t worth her sanity.

facts.fact: 队列里出现新视频：发布者用户名 JulesPublicAccessAfterworld，两天前发布、共十六次观看；画面里 early twenties 的 androgynous AMAB 说 “Save me”“I’m ready to leave this world behind”，卷起袖子露出 dozens 条割伤疤痕并掏出剃刀片，对镜头说 “If you’re watching this, David Sawyer, this is for you.”
facts.anchor: The video she’s watching was posted just two days ago. It currently has sixteen views total. The username on the account is JulesPublicAccessAfterworld.

facts.fact: Bethany 一看到像素化的血，就双击 admin panel 上的红按钮，视频连同 Jules 的 ghost-white 脸一起消失（被封禁）。
facts.anchor: Bethany hovers her index finger over the trackpad like a sheriff in an old Western. The moment she sees pixelated blood, she double-clicks that little red button on her admin panel and the video disappears
